causal_assessment.confirmed: Supervisor sampler assertion initiated owned SIGKILL; -9 records that cleanup. No wall/RSS/output cap violation is recorded, and worker MONITOR_FAILURE is absent.
causal_assessment.likely_mechanism: A task in this owned session released mm while exiting; /proc/status omitted VmRSS but the next stat snapshot still exposed non-Z state. Frequent DataLoader teardown after full VALID is consistent with counters and last 12 descendants.
causal_assessment.minimum_fix: Read state/start_ticks/session/group and field24 RSS pages from one strict /proc/stat snapshot per task; use os.sysconf(SC_PAGE_SIZE). Accept valid R/S/RSS0, reject malformed snapshots, keep exact session/group/birth, WNOWAIT/owned kill/closure/spent locks and all cap values.
causal_assessment.not_a_wrong_session_equality_branch: The asserting branch only follows same start_ticks and same session revalidation. Changed/disappeared birth/session returns continue instead.
causal_assessment.sampler_disclosure: RSS from stat pages remains sampled approximate process accounting; it does not establish instantaneous OS isolation or numerical feasibility.
causal_assessment.unresolved: The assertion records no failing PID, state or raw RSS observation. Metadata cannot prove which descendant/direct worker caused it, or exclude a generic worker exception beginning during teardown. No generic worker error receipt exists and quality/stdout/stderr logs were not opened.
causal_assessment.v1_v2_distinction: V1 primary failure was worker CUDA reserved cap at425.569s with physical exit2; observer errors accompanied shutdown. V2 has no worker cap receipt and its RSS observer is the initiating recorded failure.
causal_assessment.worker_completed_exit_before_kill: Not supported; direct worker was R in last status and terminal -9 follows supervisor kill. A naturally completed earlier exit would preserve its already-final exit status.
